title: Centering Columns with Broadcasting
learning_objectives: Centre and scale features without loops
Use np.newaxis / reshape to align shapes
hints: `X - X.mean(axis=0)` broadcasts a (d,) vector over rows.
`np.asarray(w)[:, None]` turns w into an (n, 1) column.
Replace zero stds with 1 before dividing: `std = np.where(std == 0, 1.0, std)` — the centred column is already 0.

failure_feedback.advice: Reshape w to (n, 1) with w[:, None] so it stretches across columns.
Avoid dividing by zero for constant columns; they should become 0.
Use population std (np.std default ddof=0) per column.
